items.summary: Security disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; evidence_needed for ordinary fleet operations. Evidence: fleet-doctor security baseline has not run, operations deploy/uptime/error sweeps are unavailable, and the security checklist lacks verified authentication boundaries, secret handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency review, incident signals, and disclosure readiness. TLS expiry evidence shows no certificates expiring within 30 days, but this is not proof of complete TLS coverage. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private and authorize only bounded read-only security evidence capture; do not approve public exposure, credential changes, deployment, or production mutation.

Security disposition for the Black Market Apparel capsule: conditional for report-only reconciliation; no security blocker is evidenced for ordinary site operation. Compliance records the site as passing, but the available baseline does not verify new release controls, dependency review, secret exposure, incident readiness, or site-level attribution. Exact decision: retain only the read-only unit-economics and attribution baseline; do not deploy or expand monetization until CFO and CTO review it.
